claims.disproof_condition: Downgrade if Coherent's liquid-crystal OCS fails to reach sustained commercial shipment (watch segment disclosures), or if the product family is discontinued in future filings.
claims.statement: Coherent's OCS product family for AI/ML and hyperscale datacenters is based on digital liquid-crystal technology (per its own FY2026 10-K) — a commercializing non-MEMS OCS switching technology. Relevance: (a) it is a live alternative to 3D MEMS mirror arrays at the OCS technology layer, consistent with judging MEMS substitutability 4/5 rather than 5/5; (b) vendor OCS (Coherent liquid-crystal, Lumentum) is technologically distinct from Google's in-house MEMS-based Palomar, so vendor OCS wins and Google's captive deployment are separate demand pools.
